scope: Correction to normal scheduler execution-context assumptions; not runtime acceptance

upstreamEvidence.observation: EachFrame mission handler directly calls common onFrame.
onFrame calls registered PFH CODE directly; next-frame/wait-and-execute callbacks are separate deferred calls.

normalPath: SchedulerReconcile registers CortexSchedulerTick in CBA PFH; SchedulerTick directly calls each job. Normal callbacks are unscheduled and the soft time budget is checked between jobs, not inside geometry or helper calls. Existing source headers already documented no running-job pre-emption.
correction: Earlier reviews/commentary describing geometry as scheduled or assuming ordinary scheduler suspension within normal PFH job calls were overbroad. No intra-call race is demonstrated by those source guards/tests. Distinguish stale queued input, actual deferred CBA callbacks, scheduled direct callers and evidenced synchronous re-entry.

Identity checks may protect direct calls or synchronous re-entry, but each claimed interleaving needs its actual caller/native-event evidence.
Do not remove guards blindly or equate adding isNil with measured safety/performance. Trace/reduce redundant hot-path checks against real execution paths and matched runtime measurements.

On-demand diagnostics count scheduled/unscheduled/unknown; missing legacy fields remain unknown. Existing duration/latency fields and indices remain. No new world query, worker or per-frame sort.
